subject.title: feat(ledger): instrument review and apply actions

question: Should required immutable-ledger publication failures deliberately fail the workflow job after successful primary work, while primary-result gates still permit required continuations?
rationale: The code and tests intentionally implement this split availability contract; choosing whether audit-durability failure should produce a red production job requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve split contract
options.body: Keep primary actions and continuations independent, but fail the job when required immutable receipt publication is incomplete so operators investigate.

options.title: Make ledger warning-only
options.body: Make ledger-only publication steps non-blocking so successful primary work also leaves the overall workflow job green.

options.title: Pause the ledger rollout
options.body: Hold this PR and its stacked dependents until a different durability and recovery policy is defined across all operation families.

recommendation.title: Approve split contract
recommendation.body: Keep primary actions and continuations independent, but fail the job when required immutable receipt publication is incomplete so operators investigate.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history and focused tests show direct ownership of the ledger architecture and this exact failure contract.
